title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Signals instead of shouting
hook: Can your players hear you during games?
intro: You shout instructions from the dugout.
Players cannot hear you over the crowd.
statement: A simple signal can travel farther than a voice.
q1: Do you teach a few hand signals for games —
q2: or save instructions for between innings?
q3: What do you shout most often?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But messages get through
t2: when they are simple and agreed on early.
cta: Coaches — do you use hand signals?
ctaLines: Play at first. Back up. Shift over.
Signals or wait for the inning to end?
ctaPrompt: Share your signal habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Can your players hear you during games?
You shout instructions from the dugout. Players cannot hear you over the crowd.
A simple signal can travel farther than a voice.
Hand signals or wait for the break. There is no perfect answer.
Do you use hand signals? Share your habit in the comments.
